messages:
maria: Morning — quick preflight: finance flagged unexpected spend from APAC spot pools. Can we pause any non-prod prewarms in ap-southeast-1? Need this today while they audit. tl;dr: pause non-prod prewarms + hold any large canary rollouts.

alex: Which prewarm groups? I think label is `prewarm:nonprod` for KIT pools in ap-southeast-1. I can flip the flag but want to confirm no active CI runs.

chris: I started a big warmup for the model-rollout test at 08:10, that's `pool=kit-prewarm-2`. I can abort and drain those nodes — will drop ~28 gpus. any objections?

samira: If we drop those we won't be able to run the nightly evals. Can we throttle instead of fully stopping? Finance wants immediate reduction though.

ben: numbers: non-prod prewarms in ap-southeast-1 consuming 58 GPUs across 3 pools. active canary in us-west-2 is small (6 GPUs). total spot spend spike was ~$1.9k yesterday (billing alert).

alex: OK let's scale down noncritical pools to 0.25x. I'll patch the autoscaler annotation to minReplicas=1 & maxReplicas=2 for those pools.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout `models/new-llama/rollout-2026-03-16` triggered in us-west-2 at 09:05 — 6/20 shards warmed.

maria: can we pause the ap-southeast-1 prewarm jobs only? keep us-west-2 canary going but limit to 6 GPUs. I don't want to halt the canary.

chris: I'll run drain for the kit-prewarm-2 pool and reduce target. doing now.

ops-bot: playbook snippet for quick throttle:
```
# reduce autoscaler and drain nonprod prewarm nodes
kubectl -n infra label nodes -l pool=kit-prewarm-2 prewarm=paused --overwrite
kubectl scale deployment autoscaler-kit-prewarm-2 --replicas=1 -n infra
# drain
kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

samira: pinging CI to skip overnight evals for apac. Filing TICKET-4521 for followup with finance.

maria: thanks team. alex/chris — please post a short note here when done. I will follow up with finance and close the loop. :thumbsup:

alex: done — scaled to replicas=1 and labeled pools. Kicked a short script to prevent new prewarms, PID 4221.

chris: drained 6 nodes, freed 28 GPUs. Verified no active eval jobs in queue. :white_check_mark:

ben: billing alert muted for now. I'll add a short cost breakdown to TICKET-4521.

maria: solid — leaving the canary as-is in us-west-2. if finance needs more we can further throttle tonight. thanks. :eyes:
